name: Chimichurri Skirt Steak
ingredients_verbatim: 1/2 cup (125 ml) extra virgin olive oil
700g / 1.4lb flat iron, flank, or skirt steak
unmapped_note: Board has only sirloin-steak, ribeye-steak, chuck-roast for whole-muscle beef - no flank/skirt/flat-iron home (recipe permits any of the three; sirloin-steak is a viable board substitute). Board carries dried-oregano but not fresh oregano leaves.
why: 491 cal / 38g protein / 2g carbs published at 4 servings - dead center of the band and well clear of the 35g carb ceiling. Whole-muscle steak plus an oil-herb sauce, no starch base, scales linearly to 14 servings by weigh-and-divide. No chimichurri steak in the 138-recipe beef catalog.
confidence: high - nutrition read directly from the recipe card (per serving, all sauce consumed, flat iron basis)
